topic: Factors effecting serviceability of explosives, remedial measures and safety precautions.
syllabus_extract: Factors effecting serviceability of explosives, remedial measures and safety precautions.
specific_objectives: 28.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the need for explosive regulation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of explosive storage regulations and identification of serviceability factors from IB/PDF; Instructor supervision required for safety compliance verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of explosive regulation?
List three factors that can degrade explosive serviceability.
Why is safety precaution essential during explosive handling?

development.content:
Need for explosive regulation
Factors affecting serviceability
Remedial measures for degradation
Safety precautions overview
Regulatory compliance requirements

Environmental impact on explosives
Storage condition monitoring

Documentation of serviceability status

Safety precautions during handling
Transportation safety measures
Embarkation and storage protocols
Radio hazard safety precautions
Emergency response procedures

summary_questions: Explain how temperature fluctuations affect explosive serviceability.
Describe the remedial measures taken when explosives show signs of degradation.
List the key safety precautions required during the embarkation of explosives.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the safety precautions required while handling explosives, referencing the guidelines in LP 02.
